description: Baseline 1: XGBoost with flattened window input. Demonstrates the limitation of treating temporal data as flat features. Expected RMSE: 3.5-4.5%

training.note: XGBoost uses its own training mechanism via fit() method, not epoch-based training

purpose: Baseline comparison to prove the necessity of temporal structure modeling

expected_performance.note: Should be outperformed by CNN-LSTM to demonstrate the value of automatic temporal feature learning
